title: Pullback compatibility for specified Artin--Schreier rows
statement: Let $j:C'\to C$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $p$ a prime. Let $G,G'$ be abelian sheaves on their small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], with additive equivalences $a_U:G(U)\simeq\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)$ and $a'_U:G'(U)\simeq\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)$ commuting with every restriction. Suppose endomorphisms $w,w'$ act by $x^p-x$ under these equivalences, and morphisms $i:\underline{\mathbb Z/p}_C\to G$, $i_0:\underline{\mathbb Z/p}_{C'}\to G'$ send a constant class $c$ on the constant-presheaf sheafification unit to the natural-number image of $c.val$ [def-sc-constant-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Suppose $i_0w'=0$ and the second short complex is short exact [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]. Then there are $q:j^*G\to G'$ and $i':j^*\underline{\mathbb Z/p}_C\to G'$ with $i'w'=0$, whose short complex is short exact, such that $(j^*i)q=i'$ and $(j^*w)q=qw'$. Under the inverse/direct image adjunction [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], the adjoint of $q$ sends $x\in G(U)$ to the element identified by $a'$ with the pullback of $a_U(x)$ along $U\times_C C'\to U$.

source.place: opening Artin--Schreier sequence, functoriality of its section maps under ring pullback

proof.text: Define the adjoint t:G to j_*G' on U by conjugating the regular-function pullback U times_C C' to U by a and a'. Pullback functoriality and the naturality of a and a' prove the presheaf naturality square, giving a sheaf morphism. Its adjoint q has the asserted section formula.

Ring pullback preserves powers and subtraction. Evaluate w followed by t and t followed by j_*w' at every U and use injectivity of a' to equate them. The adjunction transports this equality to (j^*w)q=qw'.

Use the canonical constant-sheaf isomorphism e:j^*constant Z/p to constant Z/p on C', and set i'=e followed by i_0. The comparison e agrees with the constant-presheaf unit. Both adjoint composites of (j^*i)q and i' send c to the natural-number image of c.val, since ring pullback preserves natural casts. Sheafification hom-ext and adjunction injectivity give (j^*i)q=i'.

Associativity and i_0w'=0 give i'w'=0. The short complex is isomorphic to the given exact complex by e on its first term and identity on the other two; short exactness transports along this isomorphism.

theorem exists_artinSchreier_pullback_rows
    {C C' : Scheme.{u}} (ι' : C' ⟶ C) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (G : Sheaf C.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (G' : Sheaf C'.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (a : ∀ U : C.Etaleᵒᵖ, G.obj.obj U ≃+ Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤))
    (a' : ∀ U : C'.Etaleᵒᵖ, G'.obj.obj U ≃+ Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤))
    (ha : ∀ (U V : C.Etaleᵒᵖ) (g : U ⟶ V) (x : G.obj.obj U),
      a V (G.obj.map g x) = g.unop.left.appTop (a U x))
    (ha' : ∀ (U V : C'.Etaleᵒᵖ) (g : U ⟶ V) (x : G'.obj.obj U),
      a' V (G'.obj.map g x) = g.unop.left.appTop (a' U x))
    (wp : G ⟶ G) (wp' : G' ⟶ G')
    (hwp : ∀ (U : C.Etaleᵒᵖ) (x : G.obj.obj U),
      a U (wp.hom.app U x) = (a U x) ^ p - a U x)
    (hwp' : ∀ (U : C'.Etaleᵒᵖ) (x : G'.obj.obj U),
      a' U (wp'.hom.app U x) = (a' U x) ^ p - a' U x)
    (i : C.constantZMod p ⟶ G) (i0 : C'.constantZMod p ⟶ G')
    (hi : ∀ (U : C.Etaleᵒᵖ) (c : ZMod p),
      a U (i.hom.app U
        ((toSheafify C.smallEtaleTopology
          ((Functor.const C.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj
            (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod p))))).app U (ULift.up c))) =
        (c.val : Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤)))
    (hi0 : ∀ (U : C'.Etaleᵒᵖ) (c : ZMod p),
      a' U (i0.hom.app U
        ((toSheafify C'.smallEtaleTopology
          ((Functor.const C'.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj
            (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod p))))).app U (ULift.up c))) =
        (c.val : Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤)))
    (z0 : i0 ≫ wp' = 0) (hs0 : (ShortComplex.mk i0 wp' z0).ShortExact) :
    ∃ (q : (Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ι').obj G ⟶ G')
      (i' : (Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ι').obj (C.constantZMod p) ⟶ G')
      (z' : i' ≫ wp' = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk i' wp' z').ShortExact ∧
      (Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ι').map i ≫ q = i' ∧
      (Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ι').map wp ≫ q = q ≫ wp' ∧
      (∀ (U : C.Etaleᵒᵖ) (x : G.obj.obj U),
        a' (Opposite.op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ ι').obj U.unop))
          (((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ι').homEquiv
            G G' q).hom.app U x) =
          (Limits.pullback.fst U.unop.hom ι').appTop (a U x))
